family.description: Unobfuscated WordPress malware kit (fabricated identity 'WP Link Helper') implementing HMAC-signed remote command handling, worm-style lateral spread to sibling WordPress installs on the same host, link/content injection, and persistence via a headerless mu-plugin (self-reinstalls from a signed remote ZIP on a shutdown hook) plus a WLH_Vault class that stashes its own PHP source inside a wp_<24-hex> option deterministically derived from DB_NAME and ABSPATH. First characterized from the vcadentistry forensic specimen (see docs/malware-families/PG-WPLinkHelper.md).

notes: known_domains/cachelayer.top is the base64-decoded value of the WLH_REMOTE_URL constant observed in wlh-config.php; WLH_HANDSHAKE is a per-deployment pre-shared secret and is NOT used as a signature (it changes across victims). ioc_strings are plain-text class/constant/cron names -- unlike PG-SC-MacroOptimizerCue, this family's code is not obfuscated, so literal-string signatures are reliable here. Per explicit mission guidance: a bare wp_[0-9a-f]{24} WordPress option name must NEVER be treated as a standalone indicator of this family (it is deliberately indistinguishable from an ordinary plugin option by name alone); it is only corroborating once one of the file-level signatures above has already fired.
